newsitem.title: USA: Avon, Mattel to launch Barbie cosmetics.
newsitem.headline: Avon, Mattel to launch Barbie cosmetics.

text.p: Avon Products Inc. has teamed up with Mattel Inc. to launch a line of Barbie cosmetics and toiletries for children.
The line will include lip balms, perfumes, shampoos, conditioners, bubble bath and hand creams, aimed at girls aged six to 12.

They will range in price from $1 to $7.50 and will available beginning in the last three months of 1997 in the United States, Canada and certain Latin American markets, with markets in Europe and Asia under consideration.
Mattel Chief Executive Jill Barad said in a statement that her company looked forward to working with Avon in such overseas markets as China.

Avon, the direct seller of beauty products and related products, also said it will again market Barbie dolls designed for Avon by Mattel. Last year, Avon sales representatives marketed the dolls. They were Avon's best-selling gift product ever, generating $40 million in sales, the company said.
Spring Petals Barbie ($54.99) will be available in the spring and Winter Rhapsody Barbie ($34.99) will be available in the fall.
A collectible, specially-designed doll will commemorate Mrs. P.F.E. Albee, the first Avon representative in the United States.

The limited edition Mrs. P.F.E. Albee Barbie doll will sell for $79.99 and will feature 19th century clothing and will come in a special showcase presentation package carrying the biography of Mrs. Albee. The doll will be availale late in the second quarter 1997 and will only be available through Avon representatives.
Avon also will market a broad range of Mattel products through its direct sales channel, including Disney, Sesame Street and Cabbage Patch characters.
Avon said the alliance with Mattel is expected to boost Avon's net sales by $100 million annually.
